items: A Kafka producer is a client application that publishes (writes) events to a Kafka cluster.
These events, also known as messages, are organized into topics, which are essentially categories or streams of data.
Producers use the Kafka Producer API to send messages to Kafka brokers, which then store and manage the data.

content.text: A Kafka topic is a logical channel to which data is published and from which consumers read.

items: replication-factor: Number of copies of data for fault tolerance.
partitions: Determines parallelism; more partitions mean more concurrent processing.
